# vendor/cfr47 — 47 CFR section text

The files here are the text of the Code of Federal Regulations, Title 47,
extracted by `scripts/vendor-cfr.py` from the Legal Information Institute's
mirror of the e-CFR saved in `resources/regulatory/` (retrieved 2026-10-08).
The regulation text is a work of the United States Government and is not
subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. § 105). LII's page furniture is removed.

The authoritative current text is ecfr.gov; it refuses scripted retrieval, so
these files must be re-checked there before any transmission campaign or
regulatory filing (SPEC-005 U-005-2).
